adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, when credential sharing is enabled it parses with `minimumTokenResponseSchema`, which does not include `refresh_token`. Since Zod objects strip unknown keys by default, `refresh_token` is dropped, and the function then injects a literal placeholder: `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"`. Call sites then persist this: e.g. Office365 merges `...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data)` into `o365AuthCredentials` and updates Prisma (`prisma.credential.update`), which would overwrite the real stored refresh token with the placeholder. GoogleCalendarService similarly calls `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)` and then stores the result into Prisma, which would also lose the real refresh token (and potentially other fields) in sharing mode.
